final: WITH g AS (SELECT s.zoneref AS zone, si.healtheval AS status, AVG(s.gbsize * 1.0 / s.spanmin) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.healtheval), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM g) SELECT g.zone AS site_code, g.status, g.avg_ratio, g.scan_count, g.avg_ratio - m.mean_ratio AS excess FROM g, m WHERE m.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL AND g.avg_ratio > m.mean_ratio ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
